title: Implement a stack-based RPN calculator in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement an RPN (Reverse Polish Notation) calculator that evaluates a sequence of tokens. Tokens are either f64 literals or operators (+, -, *, /). Returns Ok(f64) or Err(String).

required_artifacts: evaluate splits on whitespace and processes tokens left to right
operators pop two values, push result
numeric tokens are parsed as f64 and pushed
Empty expression or leftover values return Err
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
